title: Cosmic Tree Portal
description: A massive ancient tree with a stone ring and wooden door grows from a grassy islet in a calm lake. A fiery orange comet streaks across a starry purple night sky, its reflection mirrored perfectly in the still water below.
prompt: A majestic ancient tree with lush green canopy grows through a massive circular stone portal on a small grassy island in the middle of a still lake. A wooden door is open revealing an interior room with furniture. A dramatic fiery orange and red comet blazes across a starry purple night sky. The entire scene is perfectly reflected in the calm water with lily pads. Surreal fantasy landscape, cinematic lighting.
